annotations.text: CANONICAL — the decided CoGra app, split into pages (the page bar above). Every page opens with a generated flow map; boards carry small orange flow numbers, and graph.json in the repo binds each number to its outcomes — screens, terminals, or explicit gaps (designs still owed). The Entry page is fully wired; the others follow page by page. Maps and numbers are generated by the build (design/_build) — never edit them by hand. Ideation stays on its own canvases; this canvas only grows as sections are decided.

ENTRY · Arrive & browse

A guest feed is ranked from a borrowed vantage point: an invite link carries its inviter's view, a bare arrival borrows the genesis moderator's. The band names the borrowed view and carries the one join entry. The APK line rides the collapsing top (dev phase; a store link later).

ENTRY · Join

Invite entry, the vouch screen (the inviter's face leads), the unusable-link state, and the landing page of the verification mail. Handle 3–30 chars a–z 0–9 _, password 12+, both checked at the form.

ENTRY · Your key

Created on this device, never held by CoGra. 'Create my recovery code' first opens the think-twice dialog — Cancel falls back to Your key, 'Show my code' commits. The code screen is a TRAP: no back arrow, the only way out is the code typed or pasted back ('I've written it down'). Copy stays — pasting into a password manager is a legitimate keeping. Declining backup is a destructive dialog whose SAFE action is filled.

ENTRY · Applicant days

Same shell as a member, application riding as cards: verify + key first, then waiting on the inviter, then the landing moment. The first vouch opens the STANCE PAD (not sliders), preloaded at +0.10 / +0.10, resting 16px above the bottom bar. Onboarding is per-control and the pad is the ONLY control on these screens that gets first-time explainers: what it is for, how it opens (hold a face; a plain tap signs +0.10 / +0.10), that nothing signs until Set, and that the input can be swapped in settings. Acting is gated but visible (compose at 38%). The borrowed view persists until this first stance.

ENTRY · Sign in & restore

Sign in (with the APK line), password reset (no account enumeration; reset revokes every session), restoring the key, and the key-elsewhere banner. 'Restore your key' and 'Key elsewhere' carry a wording tweak: browser ('on this browser') vs app ('in this app') — the Android app says app, the web says browser. Login restores the service session; only the recovery code restores the key.

ENTRY · The intro

Five full-screen cards, shown once on the first authenticated feed entry, from applicant on; the seen flag is the server's. Skip stands on every card and leaves for the feed; Settings' About group re-watches them from the first. The illustrations are not gated by the app's own elements — but where a real component appears it is the real one, and the pad is the pad. V1: jakob iterates on these on canvas.

THE ? CONTENTS — each ? opens a plain dialog (see 'The ? dialog' board): title, at most two short paragraphs, Close. The copy, verbatim:

SEAL (post + reply) · 'Signed actions': Each piece of a post — the post itself, every topic, every citation — is its own signed action, written in your name. They sign together: all of them land, or none does. / You don't pay for these — a shared community pool covers members' signings. The pool is real and finite, so each action still counts.

LICENSE SHEET · 'The license': Terms for anyone who reuses what you publish — credit, and a public record of use. They are not a statement about how you made it. / The license is set when the post is first signed and can never change, not even by an edit. Your default lives in settings — Public domain until you change it.

SENSITIVE SHEET · 'Marking as sensitive': The mark veils the pictures and the description until a reader chooses to look. The title stays readable, so choosing is informed. / Your reason, if you give one, is shown on the veil. The mark is public and travels with the post.

KEY ABSENT · 'Your key' (the seal and the stance pad): Signing needs your key, and it isn't on this browser. Nothing is signed or sent without it — the draft stays on this device. / Restore the key with your recovery code to finish. Restoring here is the only way to complete this write.

POST PAD · 'Where you stand on it': Publishing also signs where you stand on your own post — for or against, from a gentle +0.10 by default. / Your own post always reaches you in full, so only for-or-against is yours to set. Nothing is signed until Set. Prefer sliders or exact numbers? Swap the input in settings.

REPLY PAD · 'Toward what you answer': Replying also signs where you stand on the post you answer — for or against, and how much of it reaches you. It starts at a gentle +0.10 / +0.10 and rides the same signature as your reply. / Nothing is signed until Set. Swap the input in settings if you prefer sliders or numbers.

EDIT · 'Editing': An edit replaces the whole post; earlier versions stay public under 'Edited' unless you remove them. An edit never bumps the post as new. / Topic and citation changes ride the same signing, each as its own signed action. The license never changes.

CITE · 'Citing': A citation is its own signed action and carries where you stand on what you cite. You can cite anything on CoGra — start with @handle or #topic to reach comments, messages, and offers. / Comments and chat messages can also be cited from themselves — open one and choose 'Cite in a new post'.

SEARCH · 'Searching' (the Explore tab and the citing picker): Search reads names and titles, never bodies. Start with @handle to search one person's work — including their comments and offers, found through what they point at. Start with #topic to search inside a topic. / Results put what's closest to you first — the numbers are your view, no one else's. Below the line, what's still beyond your reach, newest first. Your searches stay on this device.

FILTER SHEET · 'The filter' (the feed's and search's sheets): What you let in, and in what order — the kinds combine freely, ranked or newest is one choice, and what you've already seen stays out unless you ask for it back. Every change applies as you tap; nothing here is signed or shared. / It lasts until you change it, on this device only. Your default lives in settings.

DESCRIBE SHEET · 'Describing pictures': A description is read aloud by screen readers and shown when a picture can't load — plain words about what's there. It travels with the picture, public like the rest of the post. / Nothing is described for you: a picture without a description is skipped by screen readers, never guessed at.

PROFILE-PICTURE SEAL · 'Changing your picture': Your profile is a public record, and changes to it are signed actions in your name — the picture changes the moment yours lands. / The community pool covers the signing, like your posts. The record that you changed it stays, like every signed action.
